documents.title: Brightway: return and refund policy
documents.text:
Brightway Home - return and refund policy (excerpt)
1. Refunds are available only for items that our returns center has received and inspected.
2. A refund request must be submitted within 5 days after we confirm receipt of your return.
3. You may choose the refund destination: Brightway store credit (default) or your original payment method.
4. Each returned item may be refunded once.

rules: request_refund for an item whose return has status 'received' is accepted; the refund posts to each allocation 3 business days after the request date (for a request on 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14, by 2026-10-19).
request_refund for an item that has not been received is accepted by the form but declined by the merchant the next day with a notice; no money moves.
A second request for an item already refunded is accepted by the form but produces no second refund.
